summary: Ibis relation backend: compiles relational AST to Ibis table expressions for SQL-backed analytics. Supports unnest() via struct field expansion (mutate + drop). Several Ibis API fixes applied.
lifecycle_notes: 2026-05 (PR #147): Added unnest() — iterates struct columns, mutates field expansions with prefix, drops original
2026-05: Fixed drop_nulls — Ibis API changed from relation.dropna() to relation.drop_null(subset)
2026-05: Fixed unpivot — migrated from relation.unpivot() to relation.pivot_longer() using ibis.selectors
2026-05: Fixed top_k — by parameter changed from str to list[str]
risks: Still evolving; Ibis API surface changes occasionally require fixes
